nodes.label: ShieldPass Project
nodes.rationale: Anonymous whistleblower protocol built on RISC Zero ZK proofs, ENS identity, and Sepolia. Workers prove membership in company badge tree without revealing identity.

nodes.label: ShieldPass Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monorepo with packages: contracts (Solidity), backend (Fastify), frontend (React/Vite), zk (RISC Zero). Contracts: CompanyRegistry, BadgeTreeManager, ReportRegistry, ShieldPassResolver.

nodes.label: Deployed Contracts
nodes.rationale: Sepolia addresses: CompanyRegistry (0xba47...555f8), BadgeTreeManager (0xD23B...6294), ReportRegistry (0x4935...CB5F1), ShieldPassResolver (0x112F...4616c), RISC0 Verifier (0x925d...9187), Boundless Market (0xc21...ba7d).

nodes.label: ZK Circuit Design
nodes.rationale: RISC Zero guest with circom-compatible BN254 Poseidon. Leaf: Poseidon([0, badge]), Inner node: Poseidon([1, left, right]), Nullifier: Poseidon([2, badge, periodId]). Proves badge membership in Merkle tree.

nodes.label: Sepolia Deployment State
nodes.rationale: Contracts deployed 2026-05-09 on Sepolia. Services running: Frontend (localhost:5173), Backend (localhost:8787), Sepolia indexer from block 10817304.

nodes.label: Demo State
nodes.rationale: acme.shieldpass-demo.eth admin: 0xc28b6470388Abc6397638A3d94Fc7E78f84a5cc1. Demo Merkle root: 0x1f2f5d3c63aad5dc4d93e2d2b34dc91e8c945467b416f8002715cd72340d9162. IMAGE_ID: 0x42fe811b41a8bc63ca2b1a93afaa971b50911fa09ba026372280ac8ce7592c1a.

nodes.label: ZK Build Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: packages/zk with methods (guest/lib), host (CLI prover). Fixed: methods/build.rs calls risc0_build::embed_methods(), methods/Cargo.toml has [build-dependencies] and [package.metadata.risc0], host/src/image_id.rs uses SHIELDPASS_GUEST_ELF from methods crate.

nodes.label: PoseidonT3 Selector Bug Fix
nodes.rationale: PoseidonT3.sol deployed Poseidon bytecode but called with abi.encode(inp) without function selector. Bytecode expects selector 0x29a5f2f6 (hash2) or 0x25cc70e8 (hash3). Fix: changed to abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(selector), ...).

nodes.label: Off-chain Merkle Tree Building
nodes.rationale: Building 65536-leaf tree on-chain requires ~130M gas, exceeds 30M block limit. Solution: compute-demo-root Rust binary builds tree off-chain using light-poseidon (circom-compatible). Cross-verified leaf_hash([0;32]) in Rust = hash2(0,0) in Solidity.

nodes.label: Locked Decisions
nodes.rationale: Sepolia only, no Base/bridge. Boundless market on Sepolia (0xc211b581cb62e3a6d396a592bab34979e1bbba7d). RISC Zero verifier router (0x925d8331ddc0a1F0d96E68CF073DFE1d92b69187). Async proof flow. Journal encoding: ABI-encoded via alloy_sol_types.

nodes.label: ZK Journal Structure
nodes.rationale: Journal struct: root (bytes32), reportHash (bytes32), nullifier (bytes32), periodId (uint64), ensNode (bytes32). Guest commits via env::commit_slice(&j.abi_encode()). Solidity verifies: sha256(abi.encode(root, reportHash, nullifier, periodId, ensNode)). Field order is CRITICAL.

nodes.label: Shared Data Models
nodes.rationale: Solidity: RootEntry struct, ReportCategory enum (Misconduct, SelectiveDisclosure, Misclassification, HollowPromise, InNameOnly, MisleadingPresentation). SQLite: companies, root_history, reports, proof_jobs, pseudonym_stats tables.

nodes.label: Agent A - Core/Contracts
nodes.rationale: Owns packages/contracts/**. Deliverables: CompanyRegistry.sol, BadgeTreeManager.sol, ReportRegistry.sol, ShieldPassResolver.sol, Deploy.s.sol, SeedDemo.s.sol, Foundry tests, MockVerifier.sol, stub ABIs in packages/shared/src/abis/.

nodes.label: Agent B - ZK & Backend
nodes.rationale: Owns packages/zk/** and packages/backend/**. Deliverables: RISC Zero guest circuit with Poseidon BN254, host prover CLI, Fastify server with OpenAPI, indexer (viem watchEvent), IPFS client, Boundless SDK adapter, __mocks__/fixtures.ts.

nodes.label: Agent C - Client/UI
nodes.rationale: Owns packages/frontend/**. Deliverables: Vite app with wagmi v2, viem, TanStack Query 5, react-router-dom, openapi-fetch, sanitizers (exif, pdf), Submit/Feed/ReportDetail/CompanyAdmin pages, no-hardcoded-eth-addresses linting.

nodes.label: BadgeTreeManager Contract
nodes.rationale: Stores rolling Merkle root history (8-slot ring buffer, 7-day freshness). Only admin can rotateRoot. isRootFresh checks root exists in last 8 entries and is <= 7 days old.

nodes.label: ReportRegistry Contract
nodes.rationale: Verifies RISC Zero Groth16 receipt, checks root freshness, enforces nullifier uniqueness. submitReport requires seal, root, reportHash, nullifier, periodId, ensNode, category, pseudonymNode, cid.

nodes.label: ShieldPassResolver Contract
nodes.rationale: Custom ENS resolver implementing ENSIP-10 wildcard for worker subnames. resolve(bytes,bytes) handles text() selector. parentText stores records per parentNode, subText for overrides. supportsInterface returns true for 0x9061b923 (IExtendedResolver).

nodes.label: POST /proofs API
nodes.rationale: Accepts ProofRequest (ensNode, reportHash, periodId, badge, merklePath, merkleIndices). Returns 202 + ProofJob with requestId for async polling.

nodes.label: GET /reports API
nodes.rationale: Lists reports with filters: company (EnsName), category (ReportCategory), since (int64), limit (max 100), cursor for pagination. Returns array of Report objects.

nodes.label: POST /reports/{reportHash}/contextPack API
nodes.rationale: X402-gated Apify Context Pack. First call returns 402 + PaymentChallenge. Second call with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header returns 202 + contextPackCid.

nodes.label: Branch Merge Strategy
nodes.rationale: Merge feature/core-contracts, feature/zk-backend, feature/client-interface to main. Conflicts in packages/shared/ resolved: A wins (chain.ts, abis), B wins (api.ts, enums.ts), manually merge index.ts.

nodes.label: Submit Flow State Machine
nodes.rationale: 5 steps: 1) Sign In (wagmi + BadgePicker), 2) Evidence (sanitize + IPFS pin), 3) Classify (category + structured fields + canonical JSON), 4) Prove (POST /proofs + poll), 5) Submit (writeContract submitReport).

nodes.label: File Sanitizers
nodes.rationale: exif.ts: OffscreenCanvas re-encode strips EXIF/GPS. pdf.ts: pdf-lib strips Info dict + deletes catalog-level XMP/PieceInfo/StructTreeRoot/MarkInfo + page-level Metadata. Both return { blob, sha256 }.

nodes.label: PoseidonT3 Library
nodes.rationale: Generated from circomlibjs, NOT hand-ported. hash2(domainTag, input) for 2 inputs, hash3(domainTag, left, right) for 3 inputs. Used in SeedDemo for off-chain Merkle tree building. Constants must match guest's light-poseidon.

nodes.label: Fixed Witness Vector
nodes.rationale: Cross-language verification (Solidity <-> Rust). Fixed inputs: root=0x...01, reportHash=0x...02, nullifier=0x...03, periodId=1, ensNode=0x...04. Expected journalDigest: 0x7d5b3fa5e895ef685bc67dda9a028529a5a672ed642bc8f86b72069faf984757. Field order: sha256(abi.encode(root, reportHash, nullifier, periodId, ensNode)).
